spell.dreamstar.dream_star_domain.descri: Unfold a 40-block spherical domain for 30 seconds. A planet and galaxy shimmer beneath your feet, the sky fades into violet star clouds on entry, and stars sparkle on boundary blocks. While inside their own domain, the caster gains Dream Star Domain: +40% ice spell power, +20% movement speed, and hovering one block above the ground; hold sneak to descend.
command.dreamstar.preview: Started a 30-second domain preview (debug: no mana cost or cooldown).
